name: BilinearResize3To5
adaptation: Resize a row-major 3x3 unsigned-byte image to 5x5 using bilinear interpolation with align_corners=True. Output (h,w) samples input coordinates (h/2,w/2). Clamp the upper neighbor at input index 2. Use exact nonnegative bilinear weights and round only once, at the end, to nearest integer with half upward. Equivalently set i=h//2, j=w//2, a=h%2, b=w%2, i1=min(i+1,2), j1=min(j+1,2); Y[h,w]=floor(((2-a)*(2-b)*X[i,j]+(2-a)*b*X[i,j1]+a*(2-b)*X[i1,j]+a*b*X[i1,j1]+2)/4). The final integer rounding is the declared adaptation of the real-valued Resize operation; there is no intermediate rounding.
